docs.description: Read-only filesystem access to planning docs and prompt files. Lets agents pull docs/architecture.md, prompts/composer-system-prompt.md etc. into context without re-reading on every turn.

fetch.description: HTTP fetcher. Used to pull live Strudel docs (https://strudel.cc/learn/, https://strudel.cc/technical-manual/) when refining the composer system prompt. Also useful to spot-check generated code against the current API.

git.description: Git operations as MCP. Most agents already have git via Bash; this server is here as a fallback for tools that route through MCP only.

playwright.description: Browser automation via Playwright MCP (accessibility-tree based tooling).
